g.text: Ten episode rows per task; columns are native goal conditions
Colored cells = final condition met; gray cells = not met. Final state is shown, not whether a condition was met temporarily.
Native predicates score final placements/closure; they do not directly enforce every instruction's temporal order. Task 4: retained run set.
